title: HB0237 (113th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 39, Chapter 17, Part 13, relative to firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2023-01-17; official copy via LegiScan getBillText doc 2643315)
provenance.note: Draft as filed 2023-01-17; HB 237 and SB 10 share this document. The quote is the permit-required branch only; branch (B) lets people elsewhere carry if 21, or 18 with veteran or service status. Takes effect July 1, 2023. No amendments in the text read.

operative_text: SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1307(g)(1)): (1) (A) The person has a handgun carry permit issued pursuant to § 39-17- 1351 or § 39-17-1366 and: (i) Is in a county having a metropolitan form of government with a population of more than five hundred thousand (500,000), according to the 2020 federal census or any subsequent federal census; or (ii) Is in a county having a population over nine hundred thousand (900,000); or
